verso-plugin-vpn.description: Session grants for Verso's VPN page: OpenVPN's own config, the network config that names each tunnel's network, and the helper's read of what the tunnels are doing. The shell holds the operator's session and performs these on the plugin's behalf (ADR-007), so this file is what makes the manifest's declared acl grantable at rpcd — the plugin itself holds no session and no privilege.
